binary_hurdle_interpretation.reason: The live V5 multi-leg broker does not force-buy missing legs as taker when maker completion is insufficient. The maker-vs-taker binary mixture therefore cannot be used as the live broker's expected-PnL model.
binary_hurdle_interpretation.use: Retain the binary hurdle only as a conservative stress diagnostic for a hypothetical forced-completion policy.

runtime_broker_semantics.timeout_action: cancel remaining passive orders then unwind only filled inventory at executable bids with protocol fee and configured slippage
runtime_broker_semantics.implication: A bundle can enter COMPLETE once every leg reaches at least 75% of target. Excess fills above the common minimum fraction remain unmatched inventory risk until residual orders cancel; sub-threshold timeout economics are liquidation/unwind economics, not taker completion economics.

current_runtime_context.interpretation: The current V5 runtime exposure belongs to the child strategy books; there is no contemporaneous B2 multi-leg intent/fill evidence in this smoke.

research_conclusion.material_change: The refreshed live frontier has two maker-positive B2 candidates, but source audit shows that the previous binary full-bundle/taker-fallback hurdle is not aligned with the actual V5 broker contract.
research_conclusion.reason: The live broker completes at a 75% minimum per-leg fill fraction, caps unmatched entry risk, and unwinds filled inventory on sub-threshold timeout. No direct event-time B2 observations currently estimate the joint distribution of common completion, excess fills, timeout unwind loss, and fill-conditioned markout for the two current candidates.
research_conclusion.next_measurement: Replay exact B2 candidates 2774057 and 608565 in event time using strictly pre-arrival microprice, spread, L1/L3/L5 depth and imbalance, OFI, queue position and measured latency. Record per-leg fill hazards, the common minimum completion path, excess-fill inventory, cancel-latency fills, unmatched-entry risk, timeout unwind PnL, and 45s/60s/300s markout under 1x/1.5x/2x queue/latency/slippage stress.
research_conclusion.acceptance_target: Positive common-sample expected net execution PnL versus the incumbent after integrating the actual partial-completion/unwind distribution; static maker positivity or hypothetical binary completion probability is insufficient.
